newsitem.title: USA: Workgroup Technology names McDonough president.
newsitem.headline: Workgroup Technology names McDonough president.

text.p: Workgroup Technology Corp said Tuesday that John McDonough, hired in April as senior vice president of operations, and chief financial officer, has been named president and chief operating officer.
Previously, McDonough served as president and chief executive officer of privately-held Easel Corp, a $35 million client/server development tools company.
James Carney, founder of the company and formerly president, will remain as chief executive officer and chairman of the board and will focus on the long term strategy.

Workgroup Technology said that it believes McDonough's appointment, along with other organizational changes it had recently implemented, will result in a one-time charge of between $300,000 and $400,000 for the fiscal quarter ending June 30.
Workgroup Technology develops and markets a client/server product data management product, CMS.
